Honours Bachelor of Music with Metalworks Institute Programs and Courses
Laurier BMus with Metalworks Audio Production and Engineering Diploma Program
Structure
(
For Laurier BMus
students
taking MWI Diploma as part of their degree. BMus structure for graduates of MWI, as well as MWI courses available to Laurier students, are found in links below.)
Laurier has a partnership agreement through which Laurier students can complete the
Honours BMus at Laurier and the Audio Production and Engineering Diploma
Program
at Metalworks Institute
(15.0 credits at Laurier and 5.0 credits at MWI, of which at least 10 credits are Laurier Music courses and at least 2.5 credits are Laurier non-Music courses). WLU students attend at least six full
terms
of study at Laurier, and three terms of study at MWI, beginning at MWI at the start of year 3 (attending FallWinterSpring).
In order to be eligible to begin their studies at MWI, students admitted to WLU shall complete at least 10.0 credits at Laurier including:
 7.5 credits from the core requirements of the BMus program (as follows)
 1.0 credits from outside the Faculty of Music
MUST Courses
(1.5 credits Musical Skills and Techniques):
MUST100 or MUST101;
MUST102;
MUST103 or MUST104;
MUST201; MUST202
MUPS Courses
(2.0 credits Applied study):
MUPS1xxD, MUPS2xxD
MUEN Courses
(1.0 credits Ensemble):
1.0 credits
from MUENx11x39 series courses.
Note: Keyboard majors may substitute one of MUST381 or MUST382 toward this requirement.
MUAC/MUCE Courses
(3.0 Credits Academic Studies or Education/Community Music):
MUAC101;
MUAC102;
1.5 credits, wholly from either:
Classical Stream - MUAC211, MUAC251, MUAC252
OR
Contemporary/Commercial Stream - MUAC221, MUAC271, MUAC272
0.5 credit from: MUAC212, MUAC222, MUCE201, MUCE203, MUCE221;
Exemptions
Completion of MUAC171 shall exempt students from taking Musical Styles and Genres MUS3010T at MWI
Completion of MUST111 shall exempt students from taking Environmental Sound Workshop LIV3140P at MWI.
Completion of MUBU200 shall exempt students from taking Employment Strategies and Portfolio Development BUS1030T at MWI.
Completion of MUAC211 or MUAC221 shall exempt students from taking Music Theory I MUS3070T-01 and Music Theory II MUS3070T-02 at MWI.
The fixed Diploma program in
Audio Production and Engineering
at MWI shall award 5.0 credits toward the
BMus at Laurier,
as follows:
4.5 Music credits:
0.5 credit (MUS3110T and MUS3150P)
1.0 Credits (BUS1000T, BUS1030T, MUS3010T)
3.0 Credits (AUD2000T, AUD2150P-01, AUD2150P-02, AUD2150P-03, AUD2020T, AUD2120P, AUD2030T, AUD2170T-01, AUD2170T-02, AUD2180T-01, AUD2180T-02, AUD2180T-03, AUD2190P-01, AUD2190P-02, AUD2190P-03, AUD2110P-01, AUD2110P-02,AUD2110P-03)
0.5 credit of non-Music electives (AUD2010T, AUD2040P)
To complete their degree requirements, in addition to the requirements noted above, students shall complete:
0.5 credit of MUAC courses from the same stream they began in Year 2, either MUAC351 (Classical) or MUAC371 (Contemporary/Commercial)
0.5 credit of applied study (MUPS) at the 300-level or above
1.5 additional credits of Music courses at the 200-level or above
An additional 1.5 credits of non-Music electives
Music or non-Music electives to a total of 15.0 credits of coursework earned at Laurier

BMus Structure for MWI Audio Production and Engineering Diploma Graduates
Laurier has a partnership agreement through which MWI
Audio Production and Engineering Diploma graduates
, having earned at least a 75% average overall, can complete the Honours BMus in an additional 3 years of study at Laurier. MWI graduates earn admission to the BMus
program
through the normal selection procedures for Lauriers Faculty of Music. Graduates of MWI who audition exceptionally well may be placed at the 200-level applied study upon entry at the discretion of the audition panel.
Graduates
of MWI Audio Production and Engineering Diploma, who meet all other admission requirements to Lauriers Faculty of Music, may
transfer
5.0 credits toward a Laurier Music degree as follows:
4.5 Music credits
as follows:
0.5 credit (MUS3110T and MUS3150P)
1.0 Credits (BUS1000T, BUS1030T, MUS3010T)
3.0 Credits (AUD2000T, AUD2150P-01, AUD2150P-02, AUD2150P-03, AUD2020T, AUD2120P, AUD2030T, AUD2170T-01, AUD2170T-02, AUD2180T-01, AUD2180T-02, AUD2180T-03, AUD2190P-01, AUD2190P-02, AUD2190P-03, AUD2110P-01, AUD2110P-02, AUD2110P-03)
0.5 credit of non-Music
electives
(AUD2010T, AUD2040P)

Metalworks Institute courses available to Music students
Students
may register for any the following courses
on an à la carte basis at Metalworks Institute of
Sound and Music Production and have a maximum of
1.5 credits applied toward their BMus degree. These
courses shall be done on a
Letter of Permission
,
following normal procedures; by University policy,
courses transferred from a College may only be
counted toward a Laurier degree if the student earns
75% or above; the credit transferred does not impact
a WLU GPA calculation. Availability of courses are
subject to scheduling, without expectation that either
WLU or MWI will adjust their schedule of required
courses to accommodate these options.
